label: Unheld in being is PURE_ACT_1, from the POTENCY_1 clause and the esse instance
description: New non-transcription conditional derivation. Let f be in POTENCY_1 in some respect. By the potency clause f is in act as to being and could lack being; by the esse instance of concurrent actualization something other than f presently gives f being, so f is MOTION_3 held as to being. Hence what is not held as to being is in potency in no respect. Unheldness in every respect is more than this needs: unheldness as to being suffices. The esse-side bundle without the potency clause does not give pure act (Control part 3). Compared with the PRIOR_4 route (TruthCore/Causality/PriorityInBeing.lean), where pure act comes from act's simple priority (a4d3261a) with the respect-matched first-in-being bridge, the potency clause here plays the role of act's simple priority and uses no priority relation. Both premises stay OPEN. No premise is established.
